meta.scope_notes: Fictional data to demonstrate the report. Tested on localhost with seeded accounts for student, teacher and admin. File upload and email delivery were not tested.

summary: The core exam flow works, but one access-control bug lets any student read every other student's results — fix that before launch. On phones, the submit button is hidden behind the bottom bar, so mobile students can get stuck at the end of an exam.

functionality.why: F-001 export garbles non-ASCII filenames; everything else correct

security.why: S-001 IDOR on results API (Critical); S-002 no login rate limit (suspected)

usability.why: U-001 no save confirmation; first-timer needed 3 tries to join an exam

mobile.why: M-001 submit button unreachable on iOS Safari

performance.why: Pages load < 1 s locally; P-001 results page makes 40 sequential requests

code_quality.why: C-001 no tests for access control; errors swallowed in 3 handlers

findings.title: Students can read other students' results by changing the ID
steps: Response is 200 with student2's score and answers
findings.fix: Load the result scoped to the logged-in user, or check ownership before returning it. Apply the same check in answers.ts.

findings.title: Submit button hidden behind the bottom navigation on iOS
steps: Open an exam at 390 px width (iPhone viewport)
The Submit button sits under the fixed bottom bar and can't be tapped
findings.expected: Submit button fully visible and tappable
findings.actual: Button covered by the navigation bar
findings.fix: Reserve space for the fixed bar and the iOS safe area.

findings.title: Excel export garbles non-ASCII filenames
findings.fix: Send the filename with RFC 5987 encoding.

findings.title: No rate limit on login
findings.fix: Limit login attempts per IP and per account (e.g. 5 per minute) with express-rate-limit.

findings.title: Results page loads each student's score with a separate request
findings.fix: Fetch all results for the exam in one request.

findings.title: No confirmation after saving an answer
findings.fix: Show a short "Saved" status next to the question after each save.

findings.title: Edit and delete icon buttons have no accessible name

journeys.goal: Log in and join an exam
journeys.note: Join-code field is below the fold
S-001 — the intruder succeeding is a failure for the app

journeys.goal: Create an exam and export scores

checks.item: Ownership check on every record route

ideas.title: Automated access-control tests
ideas.why: A small test per API route asserting 403 for other users would have caught S-001 before release.

ideas.title: Autosave answers every 30 seconds
ideas.why: Mobile users on flaky connections risk losing answers; the Mobile user persona dropped connection twice.

ideas.title: 3-step "how to join" hint on the home page
ideas.why: The First-timer needed 3 attempts to find the join code field.

ideas.title: Audit log for admin actions
ideas.why: Admins can delete exams with no trace of who did it.
